phenomenon: very sparse grid plus a genuinely ambiguous boundary that only the declared inventory resolves
notes: The ASPECT x BAND grid has twenty-four cells and eight are attested, so most of the paradigm is a gap. Three codes carry an optional RATING slot, which must merge into a single ASPECT+BAND+RATING template rather than splitting off a second construction. The hard part is boundary placement: with both N and NE declared as aspects and both A and B declared as bands, NEA admits N|EA and NE|A, and EA is itself a separate attested code -- only the declared inventory plus the meanings pick NE|A. SWTcons is the deepest form and the only evidence for the full three-slot path. Problem-card numerals are arbitrary card identifiers, not counts. Domain deliberately outside the device-repair setting the pipeline was developed on.

codebook.PB1: problem card 1, wind slab on lee terrain
codebook.PB2: problem card 2, persistent weak layer at the november crust
codebook.PB3: problem card 3, loose wet on solar aspects

codebook.SBlo: south aspect, below treeline band, low hazard
codebook.SWTcons: southwest aspect, treeline band, considerable hazard
